text:
My love, my love, love found

suddenly in the oyster of death.

I want to eat with you, be with you, love with you,

I want to touch you, see you.


I tell myself so, and in my body so do

the threads of my accustomed blood,

and this pain and my shoes

and my mouth and my pillow.


I love you, love, love absurdly,

foolishly, lost, radiant,

dreaming roses and inventing stars

and saying goodbye while walking beside you.


I love you from the post on the corner,

from the carpet of that empty room,

in the warm sheets of your body

where a water of poppies sleeps.


Hair of the sleepless air,

river at night, dark banana grove,

blind hive, unearthed love,


I will follow your footsteps upward,

from your feet to your thigh and side.

translation.title: My Love, My Love, Love Found
